// ./index.js
const top_level_return = __webpack_require__("./top-level-return.js");
const compound_assignment = __webpack_require__("./compound-assignment.js");
const factory_arguments = __webpack_require__("./factory-arguments.js");
const typeof_factory_arguments = __webpack_require__("./typeof-factory-arguments.js");
const delete_reference = __webpack_require__("./delete-reference.js");
const tagged_template = __webpack_require__("./tagged-template.js");
const prototype_read = __webpack_require__("./prototype-read.js");
const prototype_custom_read = __webpack_require__("./prototype-custom-read.js");
const prototype_custom_setter = __webpack_require__("./prototype-custom-setter.js");
const prototype_indirect_object_setter = __webpack_require__("./prototype-indirect-object-setter.js");
const prototype_indirect_reflect_setter = __webpack_require__("./prototype-indirect-reflect-setter.js");
const prototype_setter = __webpack_require__("./prototype-setter.js");
const prototype_unknown_read = __webpack_require__("./prototype-unknown-read.js");
const mutable_default = __webpack_require__("./mutable-default.js");















it("should keep CommonJS factory and exports object semantics", () => {
	expect(top_level_return.g).toBe("before");
	expect(top_level_return.P).toBeUndefined();
	expect(typeof compound_assignment.toString).toBe("function");
	expect(factory_arguments.o).toBe(3);
	expect(factory_arguments.U).toBe(3);
	expect(typeof_factory_arguments.N).toBe("object");
	expect((0,delete_reference.LF)()).toBe(1);
	expect((0,delete_reference.TF)()).toBe(true);
	expect((0,delete_reference.LF)()).toBeUndefined();
	expect((0,tagged_template.run)()).toBe(1);
	expect(prototype_read.U).toBe("function");
	expect(prototype_custom_read.U).toBe(42);
	expect(typeof prototype_custom_setter.toString).toBe("function");
	expect(prototype_custom_setter.U).toBe(42);
	expect(typeof prototype_indirect_object_setter.valueOf).toBe("function");
	expect(prototype_indirect_object_setter.U).toBe(42);
	expect(typeof prototype_indirect_reflect_setter.toLocaleString).toBe("function");
	expect(prototype_indirect_reflect_setter.U).toBe(42);
	expect(prototype_setter.U).toBe(42);
	expect(prototype_unknown_read.U).toBeUndefined();
	expect(mutable_default.value).toBe(1);
	expect(mutable_default.value).toBe(1);
	const mutate = (object) => {
		object.value = 2;
	};
	mutate(mutable_default);
	expect(mutable_default.value).toBe(2);
	expect(mutable_default.value).toBe(2);
});

export {};

```mjs title=runtime.mjs

var __webpack_modules__ = {};
// The module cache
var __webpack_module_cache__ = {};
// The require function
function __webpack_require__(moduleId) {
// Check if module is in cache
var cachedModule = __webpack_module_cache__[moduleId];
if (cachedModule !== undefined) {
return cachedModule.exports;
}
// Create a new module (and put it into the cache)
var module = (__webpack_module_cache__[moduleId] = {
exports: {}
});
// Execute the module function
__webpack_modules__[moduleId](module, module.exports, __webpack_require__);

// Return the exports of the module
return module.exports;
}
// expose the modules object (__webpack_modules__)
__webpack_require__.m = __webpack_modules__;

// webpack/runtime/esm_register_module
(() => {
__webpack_require__.add = function registerModules(modules) { Object.assign(__webpack_require__.m, modules) }

})();

export { __webpack_require__ };

```
